title: run-dev.sh documents a --stats-out pass-through but never forwards the collected args
evidence:
15:# tools/run-dev.sh --stats-out

# pass-through (the app's telemetry flag) 27: *) ARGS+=("$1") ;; 34:odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+}" 2>&1 | head -20 38: PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev 41: ./bin/app-dev
detail: ARGS is collected but never expanded into either command: "${ARGS[@]+}" expands to a single empty-string argument (verified in bash), not the array, and neither app-dev invocation passes "$@". The documented telemetry pass-through silently drops its args.
recommended_fix: Forward the args: run `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev` and `./bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]}"` (drop the `${ARGS[@]+}` idiom, which never yields the elements).

title: noc_row_right is defined but never called — orphan code introduced by this diff
detail: Repo-wide grep finds noc_row_right only at its definition — no caller in app/, harness/, or tests. The spec's own doctrine is "one key, one panel, zero dead code" (the N15 anti-pattern).
recommended_fix: Delete noc_row_right (right-alignment is done by noc_col, which every fixed column already uses).

title: Draw-block comment says "F-key debug surface" but the toggle is D
evidence:
587:		// v2-noc: the F-key debug surface (the merged 5.7 + NOC overlay) draws
588:		// ON TOP of the normal HUD (last pass). PP_DEBUG builds only — the
detail: The user ruling (spec change log) dropped F and kept D as the only debug key; this comment names F in the exact place a developer looks to learn the toggle. poll.odin and the e2e drive both use .D.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to "D-key debug surface" to match poll.odin's PP_DEBUG D poll and the Key_Press{.D} e2e injection.

title: Queue-section threshold and bound are hardcoded (70, "(6)") instead of derived from the canon catalog
detail: The same function reads lane_queue_packets and pipe_amber_pct from the catalog yet hardcodes 70 (twice: measure + draw) and the label literal "(6)" — violating ODN-5 single-source and the field note "never invent ladders". A JSON retune desyncs row inclusion and the label from the bars.
recommended_fix: Pass cat into noc_queue_rows/noc_panel_rows and gate rows on warnings.pipe_amber_pct; build the section label with fmt.tprintf("QUEUES VS E9 BOUND (%d)", cat.balance.lane_queue_packets).

title: noc_panel_rows measure drifts from draw_noc_panel despite its "MUST agree" contract
detail: The count uses min(9, len(classes)) but the draw loop skips out-of-roster classes before incrementing shown (604-605), and sel_pipe adds 4 rows even when pipe_slot fails or no stats row matches. The scroll clamp overestimates — harmless blank over-scroll, but the stated invariant is false.
recommended_fix: Filter the measure with the same roster predicate (needs cat), and count the selected-pipe rows only when pipe_slot succeeds; or relax the comment to "upper bound".
